title: Planet Tweaks V3.5.1 - Full Remodel, Light & Dark Themes, Font Changer, Health Center & Hardened Safety
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.5.1 (2026-11-20): (1) Themes & App-Wide Font Changer: Added IQON Clean Light & Polar Daylight themes, Custom Theme Creator with non-destructive Live Preview, saved custom presets, and 6-font live typography switching across all open windows. (2) Collapsible Navigation, My PC & Read-Only Health Center: Added compact 64px sidebar rail, 11 modular Audio & Media destinations, sensor-aware My PC hardware telemetry, and 7-domain read-only Health Center diagnostics. (3) Hardened Safety & Persistence: Fixed OAuth callback port guard (51789), isolated Public/Private data directories, added atomic two-file AppSettings rollback & truthful save-failure handling, validated Scheduled Task startup XML, and tightened Keyboard Remapper Scancode Map batch validation.
